summary: This is a 424B5 prospectus filing for a $1,000,120,000 auto loan ABS issuance by GM Financial Consumer Automobile Receivables Trust 2026-3, with AFS SenSub Corp. as depositor and GM Financial as sponsor/servicer. The filing details six note classes with fixed and floating rates, credit enhancement via overcollateralization, subordination, and a reserve account. There is no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activism, or restructuring; it is a routine shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5). The notes are not a corporate control event, so the correct category is None.
